title: Reviewed spoken forms reach synthesis without replacing released text
purpose: Feed reviewed Japanese route terms to device synthesis while preserving the exact released spoken-text and sign identities used by offline audio and visual guidance.

limitations: This proves deterministic text rendering only; it does not verify installed voices, acoustic pronunciation, or driver comprehension.
